title: Theorem 8 bent functions outside the completed MM class
summary: Classify exactly which bent functions produced by the source Theorem 8 lie outside the completed Maiorana--McFarland class.

formal_statement.body: For every bent function $f$ generated by Proposition 1, every source-admissible direction set $\mu_1,\ldots,\mu_\tau$ satisfying $D_{\mu_i}D_{\mu_j}f^*=0$, and every Boolean polynomial $F$, classify whether $$h(x)=f(x)+F(\operatorname{Tr}(\mu_1x),\ldots,\operatorname{Tr}(\mu_\tau x))$$ belongs to the completed Maiorana--McFarland class $\mathcal M^{\#}$. Give necessary and sufficient conditions that identify all Theorem 8 outputs outside $\mathcal M^{\#}$.

scope.domain: Secondary constructions of bent functions and completed Maiorana--McFarland class membership
assumptions: f is generated by Proposition 1 of the source
The directions satisfy the source second-derivative condition on f*
h is formed exactly as in Theorem 8
scope.unresolved_remainder: Later peer-reviewed papers provide sufficient conditions and several infinite outside-M-sharp subfamilies, but they explicitly cover only strict subclasses and do not classify every Theorem 8 parameter tuple.
